name: Crowncrusher Riot
disable: DC 21 Intimidation check to force them to back down, or DC 25 Diplomacy check (expert) to request that they only injure the dottari
routine: (2 actions) The rioters lob bricks and other heavy objects at any dottari excruciator divisions as an action, dealing 2d6+10 bludgeoning damage to the dottari and any adjacent creatures (DC 27 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: While They're Distracted
items.text:
Trigger A dottari excruciator division deals damage to a living creature

---
Effect The Crowncrusher riot throws a volley of homemade explosives that deals 2d10 fire damage to the triggering creature and all creatures within 10 feet of it (DC 27 basic Reflex save save), and then rolls initiative.

text: A crew of anarchists rush to fight the dottari.
